snippet.title: Oil Sheik: Release Trailer (Short Ending Version)
snippet.description:
Oil Sheik will fully release in Q3 2025. Until then on April 25th will be a huge update with a lot of new features available in Early Access.

Download and play Oil Sheik:
➡️ Steam (PC): https://store.steampowered.com/app/2746610/Oil_Sheik/

About Oil Sheik: 
A turn-based game that combines stock trading, chess, and classic tabletop elements.
Dive into the high-stakes world of "Oil Sheik," where you'll build and merge oil companies, invest in stocks, and outmaneuver rivals to become the ultimate oil tycoon.
